The conditional frame survives on screen ('i'm going to be like' at 28.04/28.56 before the figures). Token stays unnamed: the reference-image gate was run live and returns EMPTY because the transcript names nothing. Clip 8's retitle claim was NOT imported. _patch_words.py audit came back CLEAN, 0 words restored (unlike clips 1/2/3), but 20 EDGES were re-anchored on RMS, one load-bearing: 'listed' end 26.800->26.760 and 'and' start 26.800->27.225, because a shipped gap of 0.000s hid a measured 0.465s silence and the caption break only fires once the edge is RMS-anchored. --max-secs 2.00 set as a pure GUARD, verified byte-identical to leaving it off (longest held word is only 0.57s). THE HARD-OUT IS DRY: no word-boundary silence exists anywhere in 38.6-43.15 (one gapless voiced run; the only sub -30 dB dips are stop closures INSIDE words, the /p/ of 'pump' and the /k/ of 'weeks', exactly the trap the tighten plan flagged), so no closing transient was placed. Covering the content zone is banned by his directive, so both were left untouched. Decoupling that needs either a different base segment or a licence to cover the content zone on that beat.

ALL FIVE PROTECTED BEATS measure BIT-IDENTICAL (-240 dB) added energy on the PRE-CODEC bed, so the AAC noise-floor confound cannot reach the result; the hard-out is bit-identical from 36.517 to the end against speech at -21.8 dB. Hard-out sticker verified at FULL opacity on the final frame (zero fade), though its tOut clears the flat region by only 0.1 frame, so do not lower tOut on any future edit. THE /k/-BURST AUDITION WAS MEASURED AND DELIBERATELY NOT FIXED, per instruction (a fix means a Phase 5 re-cut that would invalidate the staged render-asset): the residual is a 20ms plateau at -39.3 dB RMS, 19-21 dB UNDER the speech on both sides, contiguous with the following vowel onset, so it reads as a slightly hard attack on 'an' rather than an edit tick in silence. Adjudicated over 8 passes that the audible word is 'an', not 'got': three fresh isolated medium.en windows, the final render's whole-clip decode, and the master at p=0.95 all read 'an', and critically the BARE-SPINE control (zero SFX, provably bit-identical audio) is what produced 'got', which proves 'got' is a decoder artifact and not the mix. Rule persisted in build_captions.py PHRASE_CORRECTIONS with the measurement in its comment. BROLL-PLAN RECONCILIATION: zero executable values changed. All 7 windows, all 6 SFX cues, both sticker boxes, all 4 badge strings, seam 854 and CAP_Y 905 already matched the plan; what had drifted were 8 claims ABOUT THE WORLD, and measurement won 6 of them (graphic time 31.7% -> 29.97%, hard-out occlusion under-sized because the plan measured the 432px SOURCE png instead of its 460px rendered box, and three picture-cut timings off by 24-112 in delta terms). No decision changed and no re-render was spent on a 40ms documentation error. A GENUINE CROSS-LANGUAGE GOTCHA WAS FOUND AND LOGGED: its first pass appeared to show a 16.7ms SFX truncation plus a -51.6 dBFS click, which was its own bug, because JS Math.round is half-UP (0.55*30 = 16.5 -> 17 frames) while Python's round() is half-to-even (-> 16); the plan was right and the measurement script was wrong. Inherited derived artifacts both REPRODUCE BYTE-IDENTICALLY from their canonical tooling (captions from build_captions.py, with --max-secs 1.75 proven a no-op; whisper-words-verified.json from _patch_words.py, 126->127 tokens with 2 restored words), and the spine's dual-threshold span table was independently re-derived and matches on all 16 gaps >=0.10s. ** OPEN FOR MIKE, THE ONE ITEM THAT NEEDS HIS CALL: $IF EXPOSURE IN THE BASE PICTURE, AND THE INHERITED PLAN OVERSTATED THE MITIGATION. ** The staged spine's own screen-share carries $IF material across its final third: a burned-in live-chat banner '@MichealBlanson $if $if $if $if $if' (x 6-298, rows 672-789) from the seg1->seg2 cut at 27.640 to the end (11.96s = 30.2% of runtime), and from the seg2->seg3 cut at 36.400 a DEXScreener 'IF / WETH (Market Cap) on Uniswap' chart plus the 'WHAT IF' galaxy WORDMARK (x 864-1080, rows 56-124) legible on the last 96 frames. The predecessor's plan claimed the hard-out sticker was positioned to cover that wordmark; MEASURED, its alpha there is mean 0.2/255, max 10, 0.0% at alpha>=128, i.e. ZERO coverage. The claim was corrected rather than papered over. No blocker plate was added, correctly: an opaque bar over the content zone is exactly the class Mike's directive bans, and repositioning the mascot to cover a 216x68 px corner band pushes its ears off frame. This does NOT violate Mike's written rule, which binds the COPY ('no title/caption/description may promise $IF or 500X') and which the queue entry fully honours; it is a coherence question about his own footage. The only real fixes are upstream (a different seg2/seg3 in-point, or a picture substitution), both outside Phase 7. HIS CALL: ship as-is, or send the clip back to 4b/5 for new in-points.

Whole-file decode, control vs render: control '...Kaspa would be listed on Binance by now.' vs render '...Kaspa would be listed on Binance.' Critically, the offline SHORT-WINDOW A/B had PASSED it 13/13 clean, because the two windows that hinted at the problem were dismissed on the grounds that the CONTROL was itself garbled there. Fixed by RETIMING at unchanged 0.09 gain (t 15.34 / dur 1.50), still cutting on the impact crest at 16.84, and the clip was RE-RENDERED on the fix. LESSON: short staggered windows guard against phantom regressions but can produce a phantom PASS; one whole-file decode per candidate costs nothing and caught a real defect here. PROTECTED PAUSE re-measured at 0.655s (13.870-14.525), NOT the 0.634s the dispatch quoted, and the correction is corroborated by the sibling's independent 0.655s on the same audio at a 7.560s offset. clips.build_notes: BUILT 2026-08-10 (resumed after the account weekly limit killed the first attempt before it started; began from a VERIFIED-EMPTY disk state, nothing regenerated over an existing asset). 20.100s / 603f, -18.4 LUFS / -7.7 dBTP / LRA 3.1. 2 true-alpha overlays + 3 code badges = 5 graphic beats, 8.25s = 41.0% graphic-on-screen, painted occlusion ~3-5% of frame, inside the finished-clip band (clip 6 23.8%, clip 4 42.0%). ZERO full-screen and ZERO content-zone b-roll: checklist item 4 DECLARED NOT MET, no coverage invented. 603 frames is the CEILING (604 would exceed the 20.122s audio stream). THE HYPOTHETICAL FRAME WAS SOLVED IN FOUR LAYERS, which was this clip's whole reason for existing as a risk: (1) the in-point stays at master 2201.27 and is never trimmed to the 2208.66 peak, so 'I'm gonna be like' survives intact and unsplit at 5.36-5.98s; (2) the imagined sentence renders as QUOTED SPEECH via a NEW default-off --quote flag on the canonical build_captions.py, with an opening mark on 'holy', a close on '1.8 million.', and a RE-OPENING mark after every pause >0.45s, so the caption on screen at the exact moment the market cap is spoken CARRIES A QUOTE MARK and a viewer joining mid-clip never sees a bare figure (visually confirmed on the render at t=12.10); (3) the frame-0 cover is his words in future tense with quote marks and NO NUMBER ('I'M GONNA / BE LIKE, "I WAS / SO FREAKING / EARLY"', chip 'THAT'S WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR'); (4) a lead-in badge at 5.25-6.45s reading 'WHAT I'LL / SAY / WHEN IT HAPPENS', ending before the 0.743s protected beat. THE FIGURES GET NOTHING: no badge, arrow, multiplier, no 700M-vs-1.8M juxtaposition and NO COLOUR HIGHLIGHT (colorize is r=die gr=early, so colour lands on the win and the thing he rejects, never the numbers), and the 6.55s window 9.20-15.75 containing both figures is the clip's ONE deliberately graphic-free stretch, proven by 6 frame probes at 1.554-1.581 against a measured graphic floor of 1.49-1.58 and a weakest-real-graphic of 4.33. No ticker, logo, wordmark or digit in any generated asset: the reference gate was run LIVE against the 24 real marks on disk and returns EMPTY because the clip names nothing; overlay panels are deliberately blank and all human forms are featureless back-view silhouettes. Mike's retitle was imported into NO on-screen element. WHY A PER-INVOCATION FLAG AND NOT A PHRASE RULE: clip 4 SHARES this audio, so any token-keyed rule would have silently rewritten its already-shipped captions; verified that rebuilding clip 4's captions with the flag present is BYTE-IDENTICAL. _patch_words.py audit CLEAN, 0 words restored (the shipped pass is the SUPERSET at 73 tokens vs an independent medium.en 72, aligning 1:1), but 11 edges re-anchored and 1 phantom split merged, three of which change the screen: ' and' 3.820->4.295 (shipped gap 0.000s across a MEASURED 0.464s digital-zero pause that welded two sentences and painted a caption over the pause), ' is' 10.920->11.838 (shipped placed it INSIDE the 0.918s digital-zero beat where there is no audio, stranding a lone 'is' on screen for 1.12s across Mike's biggest pause; clip 4 independently measured the same token AFTER the beat), and a phantom split ' and'+' I' -> ' at' fixing the ungrammatical 'and i got in and i'. --max-secs 2.00 verified byte-identical to off, a pure guard above both the 0.860s longest held word and the 1.760s longest group word-span. BOTH protected delivery beats plus the third measure BIT-IDENTICAL (-240 dB) added energy PRE-CODEC across the whole protected peak 5.394-15.634, whole span AND 60ms-stripped interior; post-codec the render matches the offline mix to +/-0.01 dB and the bare spine to +0.01/+0.15 dB on every cue-free span, so there is no global gain offset, and the beat interiors reading -76 to -83 dBFS are the documented AAC noise floor (56-63 dB below speech, nearest cue 1.66-3.83s away), NOT leakage. An earlier +3.04 dB reading was its own 128k/mono control's bitrate mismatch and was chased down rather than accepted. SFX A/B offline over 18 staggered windows, ZERO renders spent: 13/18 identical to control, not one window loses a word, and 3 of the 5 diffs start INSIDE the peak where mix and control are bit-identical so masking is physically impossible. Volume was never used as a fix; four further candidate cues were measured and REJECTED rather than forced (only 3 SFX events, which at 0.149/s matches clip 4's 0.139/s on the same audio). HARD-OUT: badge3 tOut 20.50 sits past the comp end so its fade never starts, last frame at FULL opacity, the exact defect clip 2 caught. Tail luma CLEAN on both spine (min 104.61/255 across all 502 frames) and render (last 6 frames 98.5-98.8), no picture-dies-before-audio defect. Final-mix whisper transcribes WORD-FOR-WORD IDENTICALLY to the bare spine. tsc --noEmit clean. ** A LATENT BUG IN THE SHARED CAPTIONS TOOL, FOUND AND DOCUMENTED, NOT YET FIXED: ** `_apply_phrases_once` pairs span to replacement with `for w, r in zip(span, rep)`, so a PHRASE_CORRECTIONS key with MORE tokens than its replacement SILENTLY DROPS the surplus matched tokens. Concretely, ('in','and','i','like')->['in','at','like'] would have deleted the real following ' like' (14.440-14.820) and left a 0.38s hole. This is why the fix lives in this clip's own _patch_words.py as a 2->1 merge instead. Every existing rule in the file happens to be safe, but the footgun is live for the next author. ** OPEN FOR MIKE: ** (1) the new default-off --quote flag on the canonical captions tool needs his review; (2) the base picture still says what it says, independently confirmed at t=14s (DEXScreener YOLO/WETH on Robinhood/Uniswap v3, MKT CAP $3.1M / FDV $3.0M / LIQUIDITY $227K / $0.003171, a live YOLO buy-sell table, plus an 'IT'S TIME TO GO ALL-IN' third-party ad banner for the entire clip) and it cannot be covered under his directive, so the four caption layers make it materially better than a flat caption but a determined viewer can still read the picture as a position; (3) HIS RETITLE CONFLICTS WITH THE AUDIO, since 'My portfolio is filled with 100x coins.' is not said in this clip, and it was kept verbatim per the 4b retitle precedent and imported into nothing on screen, but it remains the queue title and is the single element most likely to turn the picture into a false claim. (4) GENERATION CAPTURE INCIDENT, disclosed: all three images generated correctly but the captures came back SHIFTED BY ONE (run 1 saved a pre-existing golden firework) because it ran generate-broll-reload.js against a chat already at 12/25 images instead of retiring it first as the skill advises. NOTHING was re-sent: it renamed the two correct files to their true identities and recovered the third READ-ONLY from the conversation, which also proved the off-by-one (asset pointers 14 and 15 are byte-identical to the two files on disk; 16, the newest and never captured, is the sprout). md5 across the batch public dir shows zero duplicates and all three passed persona inspection after the remap.
